Name: Ak0ifish Portraits
Author: Ak0ifish
Description:
Hello! I was inspired to practice some pixel art and created this to replace all vanilla villager portraits. :D

You will need [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]SMAPI

How to install;
[/b][list]
[*][b] ﻿[/b]Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*] ﻿Download and unzip [CP] Ak0ifish Portraits into your /Mods folder.
[*] ﻿Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list]

Thank you! This is my first mod so if there are any issues please let me know, and enjoy! <3
